institutions.name: Vrije Universiteit Brussel (VUB)
institutions.entity_note: Non-EEA applicants apply online by 31 March (31 March 2027 for 2027-28; applications open 15 Nov 2026), VUB verifies diplomas, English B2 proof is mandatory (IELTS 6.5/TOEFL 79/Cambridge 170) and a student visa is needed. VUB publishes no Turkey-specific rules: Turkish lise diploma plus the university entrance exam certificate where required for bachelors, a Turkish bachelor's degree for masters. Fees listed are the 2027/28 non-EEA tariff (2026/27 was lower, e.g. 5,720 for BSc Business Economics); BRUFACE engineering masters are registered via ULB (see ULB).

institutions.name: Universite de Namur (UNamur)
institutions.entity_note: Non-EU masters applicants needing a visa apply by 31 March with a EUR 200 fee; 2026/27 fee EUR 5,369 for non-exempt nationalities (1,194 for ARES annex countries). No fully English bachelors; no Turkey-specific rules published.

programs.name: Master in Chemistry (60 credits)
programs.application_deadline: 31 March (non-EU, visa required)
programs.requirements_note: Non-EU applicants needing a visa submit the admissions request form by 31 March (30 Sept for EU) and pay a EUR 200 review fee; no equivalence of the non-Belgian degree is required for master access; specific conditions vary per programme. Fee EUR 5,369 for nationals of countries outside the ARES annexes (EUR 1,194 for annex countries), subject to the progressive tuition decree. UNamur publishes no Turkey-specific rules. Taught in English (can also be taken in French); direct access with a chemistry bachelor, others by application.

programs.application_deadline: 31 March (non-EU, visa required)
